name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted bookmark archive with tags, lists, dead-link checks and Wayback Machine backups, backed by MariaDB, Meilisearch and Redis.

alerts.message: Open the app after the first deploy and finish the setup wizard: keep the prefilled database values (leave the password field empty) and create the account that becomes the administrator.
Email is only logged by default. Set MAIL_MAILER to smtp and fill the MAIL_* variables to enable password resets, invitations and notifications.
